entries.task_id: are dealing|with|tabular data
entries.description: are dealing with tabular data
entries.subject: are dealing

spans.text: To this day, the models that we have discussed so far remain appropriate options when we are dealing with tabular data.

entries.task_id: columns corresponding|to|features
entries.description: columns corresponding to features
entries.subject: columns corresponding

spans.text: By tabular, we mean that the data consist of rows corresponding to examples and columns corresponding to features.

entries.task_id: the knowledge|to|be able to guide the construction of fancier architectures
entries.description: the knowledge to be able to guide the construction of fancier architectures
entries.subject: the knowledge
entries.object: be able to guide the construction of fancier architectures

spans.text: Sometimes, we truly lack the knowledge to be able to guide the construction of fancier architectures.

entries.task_id: an mlp|may|be the best that we can do
entries.description: an MLP may be the best that we can do
entries.subject: an MLP
entries.object: be the best that we can do

spans.text: In these cases, an MLP may be the best that we can do.

entries.task_id: each input|to|the network has one million dimensions
entries.description: each input to the network has one million dimensions
entries.subject: each input
entries.object: the network has one million dimensions

spans.text: This means that each input to the network has one million dimensions.

entries.task_id: this network|may|turn out to be infeasible
entries.description: this network may turn out to be infeasible
entries.subject: this network

spans.text: Unless we have lots of GPUs, a talent for distributed optimization, and an extraordinary amount of patience, learning the parameters of this network may turn out to be infeasible.

entries.task_id: megapixel resolution|may|not be necessary
entries.description: megapixel resolution may not be necessary
entries.subject: megapixel resolution

spans.text: A careful reader might object to this argument on the basis that one megapixel resolution may not be necessary.

entries.task_id: be able|to|get away with one hundred thousand pixels
entries.description: be able to get away with one hundred thousand pixels
entries.subject: be able
entries.object: get away with one hundred thousand pixels

spans.text: However, while we might be able to get away with one hundred thousand pixels, our hidden layer of size 1000 grossly underestimates the number of hidden units that it takes to learn good representations of images, so a practical system will still require billions of parameters.

entries.task_id: it takes|to|learn good representations of images
entries.description: it takes to learn good representations of images
entries.subject: it takes

spans.text: However, while we might be able to get away with one hundred thousand pixels, our hidden layer of size 1000 grossly underestimates the number of hidden units that it takes to learn good representations of images, so a practical system will still require billions of parameters.

entries.task_id: are able|to|distinguish cats from dogs quite well
entries.description: are able to distinguish cats from dogs quite well
entries.subject: are able
entries.object: distinguish cats from dogs quite well

spans.text: And yet today both humans and computers are able to distinguish cats from dogs quite well, seemingly contradicting these intuitions.

entries.task_id: we want|to|detect an object in an image
entries.description: we want to detect an object in an image
entries.subject: we want
entries.object: detect an object in an image

spans.text: Imagine that we want to detect an object in an image.

entries.task_id: overly concerned|with|the precise location of the object in the image
entries.description: overly concerned with the precise location of the object in the image
entries.subject: overly concerned
entries.object: the precise location of the object in the image

spans.text: It seems reasonable that whatever method we use to recognize objects should not be overly concerned with the precise location of the object in the image.

entries.task_id: were one|to|appear at the top of the image
entries.description: were one to appear at the top of the image
entries.subject: were one
entries.object: appear at the top of the image

spans.text: Nonetheless, we should still recognize a pig were one to appear at the top of the image.

scenes
bursting|with|activities
entries.description:
scenes
bursting with activities
entries.subject:
scenes
bursting

spans.text: The game consists of a number of chaotic scenes bursting with activities.

entries.task_id: waldo|shows|up somewhere in each
entries.description: Waldo shows up somewhere in each
entries.subject: Waldo

spans.text: Waldo shows up somewhere in each, typically lurking in some unlikely location.

entries.task_id: reader's goal|is|to locate him
entries.description: reader's goal is to locate him
entries.subject: reader's goal

spans.text: The reader's goal is to locate him.

entries.task_id: due|to|the large number of distractions
entries.description: due to the large number of distractions
entries.subject: due

spans.text: Despite his characteristic outfit, this can be surprisingly difficult, due to the large number of distractions.

entries.task_id: where waldo|is|located*
entries.description: where Waldo is located*
entries.subject: where Waldo

spans.text: However, *what Waldo looks like* does not depend upon *where Waldo is located*.

entries.task_id: a waldo|detector|that could assign a score to each patch
entries.description: a Waldo detector that could assign a score to each patch
entries.subject: a Waldo
entries.object: that could assign a score to each patch

spans.text: We could sweep the image with a Waldo detector that could assign a score to each patch, indicating the likelihood that the patch contains Waldo.

entries.task_id: cnns|systematize|this idea of *spatial invariance*
entries.description: CNNs systematize this idea of *spatial invariance*
entries.subject: CNNs

spans.text: CNNs systematize this idea of *spatial invariance*, exploiting it to learn useful representations with fewer parameters.

entries.task_id: useful representations|with|fewer parameters
entries.description: useful representations with fewer parameters
entries.subject: useful representations

spans.text: CNNs systematize this idea of *spatial invariance*, exploiting it to learn useful representations with fewer parameters.

entries.task_id: respond similarly|to|the same patch
entries.description: respond similarly to the same patch
entries.subject: respond similarly

spans.text: In the earliest layers, our network should respond similarly to the same patch, regardless of where it appears in the image.

entries.task_id: this principle|is|called *translation invariance* (or *translation equivariance*)
entries.description: This principle is called *translation invariance* (or *translation equivariance*)
entries.subject: This principle

spans.text: This principle is called *translation invariance* (or *translation equivariance*).

entries.task_id: this|is|the *locality* principle
entries.description: This is the *locality* principle
entries.subject: This

spans.text: This is the *locality* principle.

entries.task_id: be aggregated|to|make predictions at the whole image level
entries.description: be aggregated to make predictions at the whole image level
entries.subject: be aggregated
entries.object: make predictions at the whole image level

spans.text: Eventually, these local representations can be aggregated to make predictions at the whole image level.

entries.task_id: way similar|to|higher level vision in nature
entries.description: way similar to higher level vision in nature
entries.subject: way similar

spans.text: As we proceed, deeper layers should be able to capture longer-range features of the image, in a way similar to higher level vision in nature.

entries.task_id: image|is|mapped to a $1000 \times 1000$ hidden representation
entries.description: image is mapped to a $1000 \times 1000$ hidden representation
entries.subject: image

spans.text: Before we carry on, let's consider the total number of parameters required for a *single* layer in this parametrization: a $1000 \times 1000$ image (1 megapixel) is mapped to a $1000 \times 1000$ hidden representation.

entries.subject: simply lead
entries.object: a shift in the hidden representation $\mathbf{H}$

spans.text: This implies that a shift in the input $\mathbf{X}$ should simply lead to a shift in the hidden representation $\mathbf{H}$.
